g.title: W1
g.text: Shield drain to GND at the dial end only (P1-8); cut back and insulate at P2.

g.title: P2
g.text: header on remote driver board (key turner)

g.title: HUB
g.text: TX2 to 1k to BUS node; RX2, BUS_X/Y/Z and P1-6 on the BUS node; STEP to P1-5; DIAG from P1-7; 5V to P1-4; GND to P1-2, P1-8

g.title: MS3_X
g.text: RAMPS X socket MS3 jumper pin (signal side, jumper OFF)

g.title: MS3_Y
g.text: RAMPS Y socket MS3 jumper pin (signal side, jumper OFF)

g.title: MS3_Z
g.text: RAMPS Z socket MS3 jumper pin (signal side, jumper OFF)
